noodle_queen.judgment: TASTE + FUNCTION + CONTEMPT PASS after Tango on the actual final render. The low rear-loaded coil, diagonal object-to-pelvis force line, whip-under-custody silhouette, early release gap, object/body clock split, collapsed chest recoil, forward pelvis overshoot, second catch, and trailing throwing arm give the specimen specific authored attitude and a readable cost of throwing while running. Economy comes from the rig rather than decorative motion; the exit keeps asymmetrical recovery debt instead of cheaply returning to the opening pose.

iterations.correction: Add an authored under-custody whip key after right-support transfer and before release; keep A_HAND custody locked through that key, shorten the release hop, and preserve the later object/body split.
iterations.highest_value_visible_defect: The first render made the support-transfer-to-release hand travel too far in one causal hop, so the fork risked reading as a teleported endpoint instead of force propagating through the body.

iterations.judgment: The rerender makes the causal chain visibly body-led: deep contralateral coil -> explicit hand-object acquisition -> loaded diagonal -> lead-foot probe -> right-support transfer -> authored under-custody arm whip -> short release fork -> object lead against chest recoil -> pelvis overshoot with throwing-arm secondary lag -> second catch/compression -> non-idle settle -> exit stride. The release is no longer one giant endpoint hop. Contact/custody changes occur only on decisive keys; support transfer precedes release; bridge motion stays curved under prior topology. No material generic symmetry, equal spacing, straight semantic tween, farthest-reach contact, floaty leverage, ownership ambiguity, reverse recoil, idle reset, or missing recovery debt remains in the actual 152-frame render.
